positions.name: AsyncJobContractTerms
positions.frame: what did the team ratify as the guarantees and mechanism of remember's async job contract?
positions.why: All three segments describe facets of the same single ratified contract — the announcement of ratification (src-1), the guarantees it secures (src-2: no blocking, no lost work), and the mechanism by which it's fulfilled (src-3: dispatch-then-poll-or-piggyback). Across the directional reads they share a settled, low-arousal 'calm-positive' affect and a decision-grade conviction, and register consistently flags native pipeline jargon deployed as self-contained maxims — the same voice describing one thing from three angles rather than three separate claims. No tension to hold: they build on each other (what was ratified → what it guarantees → how it operates) rather than opposing.
